content: Sneha Roy discussed her auto insurance renewal quote with insurance agent Anjali Desai. Sneha requested to increase her deductible to $1,000, which resulted in a new annual premium of $1,250. Anjali provided the revised quote and informed her that the policy will take effect on 01/10/2026 pending signed documents. Sneha confirmed she will e-sign and return the documents today.

action_items: Anjali Desai to send updated documents for e-signing
Sneha Roy to sign and return the documents today
